defense_news.title: Boeing wins first production contract for jet-powered JDAM
defense_news.summary: Boeing won the first production contract for a jet-powered guided bomb that can fly more than 300 nautical miles.

defense_news.title: Iran issues warning to Gulf states: US must desist or you’ll be hit hard
defense_news.summary: Iran has made a concerted push with Gulf states, warning them explicitly that Tehran will hit their oil, power and water plants unless U.S. strikes end.

defense_news.title: Rheinmetall scales down 2026 sales outlook on scrapped frigate program
defense_news.summary: German defense company Rheinmetall lowered its 2026 sales outlook on Thursday after the German government canceled a delayed frigate program.

defense_news.title: Trump-class battleship program will cost $275 billion, CBO report says
defense_news.summary: The Congressional Budget Office estimates the Navy’s new Trump-class battleship program will cost $275 billion, with the first ship costing $23.4 billion.

geo_news.title: Menderes Belediyesine yönelik soruşturmada gözaltına alınan Başkan Çiçek ve 15 şüpheli adliyede
geo_news.summary: İzmir'in Menderes Belediyesine yönelik soruşturmada gözaltına alınan, aralarında Belediye Başkanı İlkay Çiçek'in de bulunduğu 16 şüpheli adliyeye sevk edildi.

geo_news.title: Tatlı su ile Van Gölü'nün buluştuğu noktada doğal desenler oluştu
geo_news.summary: Bitlis'in Adilcevaz ilçesinde, Van Gölü'ne dökülen tatlı su kaynağının gölle buluştuğu alanda turkuaz ve beyaz tonlarda doğal desenler oluştu.
